decisions: Phase 7 starts from factual Phase 6 completion: direct-recursion solving, BIG1005, docs, and tests are present and Release tests pass.
Custom analyzer behavior configuration will use Roslyn AnalyzerConfigOptionsProvider or an equivalent analyzer config mechanism, not a manual .editorconfig parser.
Custom options use the complexity_analyzers.* prefix and preserve current Phase 6 behavior by default.
Public budgets default to the real current values: max_call_depth = 5 and max_methods_per_root = 32, with hard limits retained.
BIG1006 is reserved for configurable method complexity threshold reporting because no existing diagnostic uses that ID.
NuGet readiness remains validation-only in this phase: no NuGet.org publication, GitHub Release, tag, push, or publish token.
The Phase 7 options model is immutable, contains no SyntaxNode types, and has explicit defaults.
ComplexityAnalyzerOptionsReader reads global and syntax-tree options through AnalyzerConfigOptionsProvider; tree-specific options win over global options.
Boolean options accept only true and false, case-insensitively after trimming surrounding whitespace; invalid values fall back to the option default.
Integer options use invariant-culture base-10 parsing after trimming surrounding whitespace; signed values, decimals, separators, negative values, and values above hard limits fall back to defaults.
Public budget hard limits are max_call_depth = 16 and max_methods_per_root = 128.
maximum_complexity accepts only the Phase 7 grammar values none, constant, log_n, n, n_log_n, n2, n3, exponential, and factorial; unknown values fall back to none.
The exponential threshold currently maps to the existing comparable model form O(2^n).
Feature flags and public budgets are now integrated into the analyzer pipeline while preserving default Phase 6 behavior.
Tree-specific options are cached per SyntaxTree through the interprocedural analysis context; root budgets remain root-scoped.
Source-method expansion is disabled by complexity_analyzers.interprocedural_analysis=false while BCL/LINQ known operations remain active.
Direct recurrence extraction and solving, including BIG1005, are disabled by complexity_analyzers.recursion_analysis=false.

Method complexity template cache entries are keyed by source method plus template-affecting feature/budget options, excluding maximum_complexity because threshold reporting is not implemented yet and does not change templates.
